name: 1250 A overhead plug-in busway
summary: Overhead plug-in busway rated 1250 A at 415 V three-phase, about 854 kW at a 0.95 power factor (√3 × V × I × PF).

ratingA.note: Class rating; a standard busway frame size.

voltageV.note: 415/240 V three-phase is the common data-hall distribution voltage in North American and European IT halls.

powerFactor.note: Server power supplies with active power-factor correction run at 0.95–0.99 above half load.

capexUsdPerM.note: Judgment for copper plug-in busway installed overhead, including supports, excluding tap-off boxes.

leadTimeWeeks.note: Judgment: copper busway lead times stretched with data-center demand in 2024–2025.
